nom: Rael Miracle Patch Overnight Spot Cover

segments.sensitive: Reports from reviewers with sensitive skin genuinely diverge: one found the microcrystal texture uncomfortable to apply and remove though her discoloration spots faded slightly, another found the adhesive abrasive on removal despite the patches working well on her blemishes, and a third had no irritation at all and says the treated area wasn't dried out.

concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report pimples visibly flattened, drained, or gone within one night to a few days, including on cystic and underground bumps that other brands failed to treat; a notable minority disagree, saying the patches did nothing, worked slower than competing brands, or in a couple of cases appeared to make small pimples look larger and redder.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report visibly less inflammation and redness within hours of applying a patch; two reviewers had the opposite experience, one seeing a pimple turn into an inflamed red dot and another developing what she describes as an allergic reaction with a lingering red mark days after use.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with sensitive skin reports a mild decrease in discoloration spots overall with regular use, alongside discomfort from the patch's textured surface.
concerns.dehydration: A few reviewers, including one with sensitive skin, note the treated area is left feeling moisturized rather than dried out; no reviewer reports the patches drying out surrounding skin.

aspects.libelle: Acts as a barrier, stops picking

extraits.texte: I have used a fairly large variety of spot patches and hydrocolloid based acne covers with mixed at best success. As with related products, I placed the Miracle Patches on problem areas after my p.m. skin care routine and left them on throughout the night. While I noticed a mild decrease in discoloration spots overall, the microcrystals were fairly uncomfortable during both application and removal. I imagine this is due to my sensitive skin's reaction to either the spiny texture of the microcrystals or the addition of succinic acid and tea tree oil on the patches. They may be fine for folks with more hearty skin than myself, but I have no interest irritating my skin with these further.

extraits.titre: Works very well, tough on sensitive skin
extraits.texte: These spot patches work wonders but are tough on sensitive skin. The adhesive was a bit abrasive and uncomfortable when removing, but also worked wonders at reducing/removing blemishes as well. Would definitely recommend this product!

This package cam just in time. I had a HUGE pimple pop up out of nowhere. I used this patch immediately over night. When I woke to a decrease in its size. It was very comfortable and didn't seem to dry the area out too much. the spot was free from irritation as I can have sensitive skin.

Sadly the don't work as expected.Photos & review show the patches seemingly drawing puse out of acne & thus aiding in less visible ache & a faster healing process - this is not the case. When you wear a patch for a night & take it off the the next day the patch turns white, however not due to extraction an puse from a pimple, it seems like a reaction the medicine on the patch. The first time I tried this I wonder if the pimp I had seemed to grow wider after I used it, but hard to know without actually seriously taking not of the pimp size before & after. My sister saw patches I want to try them, I didn't comment & let her try them...next am she said what this zit is twice the width. I found it hard dto believe that this was really what happened, so I used multiple patches all over my face & can conform that small pimples when to almost twice the size red dots. I will not be using them again. That being said if you want a patch to cover (not treat) a zit, they do hid a red acne spot well. Coverup seem like a better route though.

Honestly these are great for your face they stick really well and suck up a lot that you didnt know was there, unfortunately i get really bad boob pimples and it was gojng great at first until i noticed today that it caused a allergic reaction (i havent put one on for atleast two weeks) i have a super red circle hopefully it goes away but other than that i will continue to use on my face

I liked that these patches really stuck to my skin with no worries of peeling off while sleeping. I also like how clear these are—you really can hardly see them on so Ive even worn them running errands. However, unlike their top brand competitors, these do take a few days to see healing. Some pimples they don't work on at all. I have had to use these a few nights in a row to see reduction and a different brand i have tried i saw almost complete healing in one night! So in my opinion these are okay, but there are other brands that work faster and worth spending a few dollars more on.
